statement: Russian strikes damage fuel or electric power infrastructure in Kyiv city or Kyiv oblast on at least three separate calendar days between 2026-09-12 and 2026-10-11.
resolution: At least two of Reuters, AP, AFP, or the Guardian, citing Ukrainian officials, report such infrastructure damage in Kyiv city or oblast on three or more distinct dates between 2026-09-12 and 2026-10-11; otherwise MISS.
failure_condition: Qualifying infrastructure damage in Kyiv city or oblast occurs on fewer than three distinct calendar days inside the window.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.

statement: At least one commercial merchant vessel is struck by a missile, drone, or uncrewed surface vessel in the Red Sea, Bab al-Mandab, or Gulf of Aden between 2026-09-12 and 2026-10-11.
resolution: A UKMTO advisory, or Reuters or AP reporting citing UKMTO or the vessel operator, records a munition strike on a commercial vessel in those waters between 2026-09-12 and 2026-10-11; otherwise MISS.
failure_condition: No commercial merchant vessel in the named waters is struck by a munition during the window.
